fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Birmingham teaches its master's courses on the Edgbaston campus in Birmingham. Its one-year master's courses cover computer science, data science and business. This page covers three of them.

The most important thing to know is the fee. The course page shows the UK and Ireland fee first. For MSc Computer Science starting September 2027, that fee is £12,780. It does not apply to you. Select India on the course page to see the international fee, which is **£36,000** for the same course.

| Fact | Detail |
|---|---|
| Campus | Edgbaston, Birmingham |
| Length | 1 year full-time |
| Start dates | MSc Computer Science: September or January. MSc Data Science and MBA: September |
| Tuition for international students | MSc Computer Science: **£36,000** for September 2027 |
| English test (IELTS) | 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any band, for Computer Science and Data Science |
| Degree needed | 2:1 honours in a subject other than computing, for Computer Science |

## What it really costs

### Tuition

- **MSc Computer Science, September 2027:** £36,000
- **MSc Computer Science, January 2027:** £34,740
- **MBA (full-time), September 2027:** £40,410

The Computer Science course lasts one year full-time. The figures above are for the whole course.

### Deposit and visa fees

Before the university can issue your CAS, you must pay a tuition fee deposit. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter from your university that you need for your visa. Confirm the deposit amount with the university before you plan your payments.

### Living money for your visa

For a UK student visa, you must show that you can pay for your living costs. Outside London, the rule is **£1,171 for each month of your course**, up to 9 months. You must have this money in your bank account for 28 days in a row. The end of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the date you apply. This is proof you show to the visa team. It is not a payment to the university. Birmingham is outside London, so the outside-London figure applies to you.

### Worked first-year cost: MSc Computer Science, September 2027

| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Tuition, September 2027 | £36,000 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK (from 8 April 2026) | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of your visa | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £47,873** |

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

The sum of the fixed items is £36,000 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £47,873, so the total is at least that. The £10,539 is money you must show for the visa. It is not a fee paid to the university. The total is an example for this one course. It does not include your travel or housing costs.

For how the visa works, read our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

If you start in January 2027, tuition is £34,740. The visa deadline for a January 2027 start was 30 October 2026, so it has passed.

## Ways to reduce the cost

For 2027 entry, the one open award on the Computer Science and Data Science course pages is the Alumni Scholarship. It gives **£3,000 off tuition** for returning Birmingham undergraduate alumni who start a master's in 2027. Apply by **31 July 2027**. It is not open to general Indian applicants. If you did not study an undergraduate degree at Birmingham, this award does not apply to you.

The other awards listed for Indian students do not apply to 2027 entry.

## What you need to get in

**Degree.** The Computer Science course asks for a 2:1 honours degree in any subject other than computing. A 2:1 is the UK grade for an honours degree, known as a second-class upper.

**Indian marks.** Birmingham's India country page says a UK 2:1 is equivalent to 55% to 60% or higher. Confirm how your marks convert with the admissions team.

**English.** IELTS is an English test. Computer Science and Data Science ask for IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any band. For the MBA, check the course page for its English requirement.

**Visa English.** The UK student visa needs English at CEFR level B2 for a degree-level course. CEFR is a common scale for rating language ability.

## Deadlines

| Course | Start | Deadline if you need a visa | Deadline if you do not need a visa |
|---|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | January 2027 | 30 October 2026 (closed) | 18 December 2026 |
| MSc Computer Science | September 2027 | Check the course page | 27 August 2027 |
| MSc Data Science | September 2027 | Check the course page | 27 August 2027 |
| MBA (full-time) | September 2027 | Check the course page | 27 August 2027 |

The non-visa deadline does not apply to you if you need a visa. Check the visa deadline for September 2027 on the course page before you plan.

You can apply for a UK student visa up to 6 months before your course starts, from outside the UK. The UK government says decisions usually take about 3 weeks for applications from outside the UK. Apply early so your visa arrives in time.

Some courses need an ATAS certificate. ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) applies only if your course and nationality require it. You must have it before you start the course. Check the [gov.uk ATAS page](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme) for your course.

## Courses covered on this page

This page covers three courses:

- **MSc Computer Science.** Starts in September or January. Requires a 2:1 in a subject other than computing.
- **MSc Data Science.** Starts in September. Requires IELTS 6.5, with no less than 6.0 in any band.
- **MBA (full-time).** Starts in September 2027.

Related courses in the same department include the Artificial Intelligence (AI) MSc, the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning MSc, and the AI in Management MSc. The Strategic Marketing and Consulting MSc is a related course for the MBA.

## Where you'll live

The campus is at Edgbaston, Birmingham B15 2TT.

**Accommodation guarantee.** New international postgraduate students can apply and book by **31 July 2027** under the university's accommodation guarantee. Booking for postgraduates opens in early February 2027.

The table shows postgraduate room rates for 2026/27. Check the accommodation office for 2027/28 prices before you plan your budget.

| Room type | Per week | Total for the year (2026/27) |
|---|---|---|
| Shared bathroom | £107 to £167 | £5,335 to £8,332 |
| En-suite | £189 to £222 | £9,445 to £11,059 |
| Studios and apartments | £250 to £360 | £12,750 to £17,966 |

Rooms at Oak Brook Park cost £215 to £219 a week.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- you have a 2:1 honours degree, or an Indian degree that converts to a 2:1, in a subject other than computing
- you want a one-year UK master's and can start in September 2027
- your budget covers the first-year total of at least £47,873 in the worked example above

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in computing, because this course asks for a different subject
- your IELTS score is below 6.5 overall, or below 6.0 in any band
- you need to start in January 2027, because the visa deadline has passed

To compare this total with other UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

faq_json.q: How much is tuition at the University of Birmingham for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For MSc Computer Science starting September 2027, tuition for international students is £36,000. The January 2027 start is £34,740, and the full-time MBA starting September 2027 is £40,410.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for the University of Birmingham?
faq_json.a: For MSc Computer Science and MSc Data Science, you need IELTS 6.5 overall, with no less than 6.0 in any band. Check the MBA course page for its English requirement.

faq_json.q: What percentage do I need to get into Birmingham from India?
faq_json.a: Birmingham's India page says a UK 2:1 is equivalent to 55% to 60% or higher. Confirm how your marks convert with the admissions team.

faq_json.q: Can I do the MSc Computer Science at Birmingham with a computing degree?
faq_json.a: No. The course asks for a 2:1 honours degree in any subject other than computing.

faq_json.q: What is the Birmingham deadline for September 2027 for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For applicants who do not need a visa, the deadline is 27 August 2027. Indian students who need a visa should check the visa deadline on the course page before they plan.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship at Birmingham for Indian students for 2027 entry?
faq_json.a: Not for general Indian applicants. The only award open for 2027 entry is the Alumni Scholarship, worth £3,000 off tuition for returning Birmingham undergraduate alumni, with a deadline of 31 July 2027.
